test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 12 April 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Who among the following is the author of the novel ‘Q and A’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vikas Swarup.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vikas Swarup is the author of the novel ‘Q and A’.**
 
• Vikas Swarup served as the Secretary of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, India, and previously worked in Canada as the High Commissioner of India and was the official spokesperson for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of India.
 
• He is a 1986-batch officer of the Indian Foreign Service and is at present India’s High Commissioner in Ottawa.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Prof. Muchkand Dubey is the President of CSD (Council for Social Development).
 
• **​Jyotindra Nath Dixit** is the author of Bharatiya Videsh Neeti, India-Pakistan in War and Peace, Bharat-Pak Sambandh.
